description: VC-RoE (Vibe Coding · Rules of Engagement) hooks: SessionStart injects the matching slice and writes the heartbeat anchor; UserPromptSubmit emits the elapsed-time clock tag and OVERDUE flags per D-MET-33; PostToolUse mirrors the clock tag during autonomous-work windows where no user prompt fires (added v1.1.0); Stop greps the assistant transcript for the heartbeat sentinel and advances LAST_HEARTBEAT (layered fail-safe per D-MET-41). Renamed from vc-roe at v1.0.0.
